verdict.rationale: Vercel documents on-demand server-side compute through Fluid compute, which scales concurrency, and says it can deploy and scale web apps and APIs. That is a direct but thin match to the scaling half of the story. Nothing in the evidence addresses boot or cold-start latency, and no scale figures are given. missing for 10: any documented sub-second boot/cold-start time, evidence of scaling to tens of thousands of instances under load, autoscaling limits or behavior details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load

citations.quote: Run server-side code on demand with Fluid compute, which scales concurrency for AI and I/O-heavy workloads.
Deploy and scale web applications, APIs, and AI workloads from a Git repository or the Vercel CLI.
